hints.content: The general explicit formula for arithmetic sequences is $\blueD{a_1}+\maroonD{d}(n-1)$, where $\blueD{a_1}$ is the first term and $\maroonD d$ is the common difference.

The first term is $\blueD{10}$ and the common difference is $\maroonD{-20}$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{-20\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-20\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-20\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$\blueD{10},$ | | $-10,$ | | $-30,$ | | $-50,...$

This is the explicit formula for the arithmetic sequence $10,-10,-30,-50,...$.

$c(n)=\blueD{10}\maroonD{-20}(n-1)$

*Note that this solution strategy results in this formula, however an equally correct solution can be written in other equivalent forms as well.*
